title: Roast chicken salad with cucumber, radishes and dill

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple: chicken, vegetables, lemon, natural yoghurt, oil and herbs.

supermarket.reason: Whole chicken, new potatoes, Little Gem, radishes, cucumber and dill are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, grater, sieve and bowls, and roasting a chicken is well within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: Eighty minutes at 190°C fan suits a 1.5kg chicken, 50 minutes suits halved new potatoes, and the quantities comfortably feed four.

honest_times.reason: About 30 minutes of halving, slicing, mixing and pulling is believable, and 110 minutes total matches 80 minutes roasting, 15 resting and the prep.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient appears in the steps, the three tablespoons of oil add up, and Little Gem is simply lettuce.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm chicken and new potato salad with cucumber, radishes and dill suits mid May, and the cucumber is a main part of the salad, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, practical British English, such as explaining why the cucumber is salted, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Roast chicken, potatoes and plenty of fresh vegetables make a proper, filling family dinner.
